name: MNN GitHub repository (Alibaba)
notes: MNN README: lightweight inference engine for mobile/embedded, with a growing LLM story (MNN Chat apps for Android and iOS, Qwen2.5-Omni 3B/7B, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1 1.5B, Qwen3-VL, and Qwen3.5 series announced 2026-03-05). The differentiating backend line is the 3.6.1 release (2026-07-22) adding a Qualcomm Hexagon DSP backend, alongside the usual CPU/Vulkan/OpenCL/CUDA set. API metadata 2026-10-03: created 2019-04-15, last push 2026-09-30, 3.6.1 (2026-07-23), Apache-2.0, 3596 open issues, 16171 stars.
